headline: Argentina Targets European Soymeal Market Share Amid Deforestation Rule Tightening
summary: Argentine agribusiness exporters expect expanded market opportunities for soybean meal in Europe as tighter EU deforestation regulations hamper Brazilian agricultural exports.
why: Argentina and Brazil compete directly as top global exporters of processed soybean products, making environmental compliance rules key determinants of export market share.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Exporters stand to gain European market volume if regional competitors face EU compliance compliance delays.
